# Rokae xCoreSDK Python Runtime

This directory vendors the Python runtime files from:

```text
xCoreSDK-v0.7.1.ar_5/build/pyrokae
```

Included files:

- `pyrokae.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so`
- `pyrokae.pyi`
- `librokae_sdk.so.0.7.1`
- `libxCoreSDK.so.0.7.1`
- `__init__.py`

The binary extension is built for Linux x86_64 and CPython 3.10. Use a matching Python interpreter for real hardware runs, or rebuild the SDK and replace these files.
